title: Kusei basic actions: generated key poses, not full in-betweens
coordinate_system: pixels; origin top left; x right; y down
measurement_method: Manually inspected source images with 100 px grid. Head crown-to-chin axis, approximate hidden shoulder joint centers. Precision estimated +/- 5 px for visible head/weapon landmarks, +/- 12 px for joints/grips. Not a calibrated skeleton.

normalization.operation: uniform downscale only using crown-to-chin length; transparent padding; root translation; no per-frame bbox fit, no upscaling, no limb warping
normalization.status: Uniform downscaling and root alignment; head-axis baseline for upright poses, body/foot-span corrections for bowed heads. Projected head height is allowed to vary when tilted.

global_cautions: Key-pose flipbooks; no motion interpolation or skeletal rig.
Bodies aligned by a common anatomical scale and ground root, never by total bounding box. Normal upright poses use head reference; bowed and recovered poses use same-pose torso/leg/foot evidence.
Fixed-layer and native-drawn weapon frames are listed separately in weapon_policy.
Near/far contact alternation has been visually checked in the new walk sequence and the color-tagged reverse-run pose. The reused flight key does not provide full alternate-side inbetweens.
down_01, weapon-length repair experiments, and initial text-only gait candidates remain source-only.

v4 idle is one original body master in three articulated joint poses, with three generated posture studies retained but not selected. It is not three independent full-body redraws; v3 local-patch idle was rejected.

phase_order: near support with far rear swing
near leg backward / far forward crossover contact
near knee forward with far support
far-leading contact with near thigh crossed in front and trailing backward
retreat_run.note: Not a sped-up walk. Lean, airborne pose and backward cloth are original running poses; far-leading contact is a distinct generated pose.

native_occlusion_review.review_basis: Both native clean actor images inspected at full resolution; temporary color study used only as provenance, not sole evidence.

run_03.near_leg: Screen-left/front leg: visible dark thigh flap near (453,813) lies over the robe edge and continues toward left/front shin and foot (346,1205).
run_03.far_leg: Screen-right/back shin appears from behind the white robe near (943,901), continuing to rear foot (1100,1079).
run_03.limitation: Hip/crotch connection is partly concealed by overlapping robes, so continuous near/far tracing is not completely exposed.

run_opposite_final.near_leg: Foreground thigh panel emerges below the center tassel near (520,744), crosses diagonally over the other thigh, and continues to screen-right/back knee/shin near (898,927), rear foot (1090,1138).
run_opposite_final.far_leg: Screen-left/front thigh emerges from behind that crossing panel near (410,772), continuing to front shin and foot (275,1198).
run_opposite_final.limitation: At 0.5 preview scale, both contact silhouettes still resemble a left/front and right/back stride; swap readability depends on the central trouser overlap.

native_occlusion_review.conclusion: Opposite near/far assignment is supported by native trouser occlusion. Overall front/back foot silhouette is similar, and run_03 has partial hip occlusion. Three unique running keys with shared flight remain a simplified cycle, not a full run animation.

qa_summary.gait_contact_alternation: Native trouser occlusion supports opposite run contact; run_03 partly obscured, documented confidence moderate.
qa_summary.caveat: This is anatomy-scale/anchor QA, not a claim that all projected head heights or drawn silhouettes are identical.
qa_summary.idle_body_scale_drift: zero global scale change; reference bone lengths and head axis identical across articulated keys; planted feet pixels fixed

idle_v3.basis: Same idle_01 full-body pixels for all states. Only generated interior cloth/lower-bead patches are composited. No per-frame body transforms.

idle_v4.method: 3 articulated pose keys derived from one anatomy master. Generated new drafts retained but not selected because of framing/pose-amplitude drift.

idle_v4_01.basis: Single native anatomy master articulated through torso/head rigid transforms and two-bone holding-arm IK; no whole-frame resizing between poses. Imagegen v4 drafts are posture studies only.
idle_v4_01.deformation_method: Piecewise-affine native mesh driven by rigid anatomical segment controls and two-bone IK; feet below native y1260 copied exactly from base. The mesh interpolates attachment/drape transitions between rigid control regions.
